name: us-energy-consumption-by-source
title: US Primary Energy Consumption by Source, 1635-2025
description: US primary energy consumption by source (coal, natural gas, petroleum, nuclear, hydroelectric, geothermal, solar, wind, wood, biomass) in quadrillion Btu, from the US Energy Information Administration (EIA). EIA's historical estimates for selected years 1635-1945 (every 10 years to 1845, every 5 years from 1850) are joined, unchanged and not interpolated, with EIA's annual series for 1949-2025 from Monthly Energy Review Table 1.3 (wood from Table 10.1). Each row records the EIA table it comes from. There are no figures for 1946-1948.

resources.name: energy-consumption
resources.title: US primary energy consumption by source and year

fields.name: year
fields.description: Calendar year. 1635-1845: every 10 years (each value is the annual average of the decade, assigned by EIA to the decade's fifth year). 1850-1945: every 5 years. 1949-2025: every year. No data for 1946-1948.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Energy source: coal, natural_gas, petroleum, fossil_fuels_total, nuclear, hydroelectric, geothermal, solar, wind, wood, biomass_total, renewables_total, electricity_net_imports (1915-1945 only), total_primary.

fields.name: quadrillion_btu
fields.description: Primary energy consumption in quadrillion (10^15) British thermal units, as published by EIA (3 decimals for 1635-1945, full precision for 1949 on). Empty when EIA prints (s), less than 0.5 trillion Btu (see flag).

fields.name: flag
fields.description: s = EIA prints (s), less than 0.5 trillion Btu, so the value is left empty. Otherwise empty.

fields.name: is_total
fields.description: true for the subtotal and total rows (fossil_fuels_total, biomass_total, renewables_total, total_primary). Do not add these to the individual sources.

fields.name: source_table
fields.description: EIA table the value comes from: D1-1635-1945 (historical estimates, selected years), MER-1.3 (Monthly Energy Review Table 1.3) or MER-10.1 (Monthly Energy Review Table 10.1, wood only, converted from trillion Btu).
